methodology: Extracted every exercise-line ex.name across somax-app/src/data/library/**/*.json (excluding meal files): 5,856 raw references, 3,267 distinct raw strings. Diffed against muscle-verification.json's 1,176 case/whitespace-deduped movements (tier-suffix stripping applied the same way the original research describes) to get the residual gap: 2,003 library strings not covered by the first pass. Each residual string then went through: (1) a loose-normalized cross-check against images/manifest.json's movementNamesCovered aliases and muscle-verification.json's own movement names (plus a token-overlap fuzzy pass, manually reviewed line by line) to rescue false negatives already covered under different phrasing - 171 found this way; (2) rule-based + manual-sample noise classification mirroring the ORIGINAL research's own documented exclusion categories (cardio pacing/interval/distance labels, sport-specific drills and team-game footwork, boxing/combat combo rounds, golf swing-coaching cues, pure balance/fall-prevention holds, CARs-named neck/wrist/shoulder rehab-prep drills, pelvic-floor/breathing drills, band-assisted mobility drills with no strength analogue) - about 1,005 strings excluded this way; (3) circuit/complex decomposition for AMRAP/EMOM/warm-up-cooldown freeform lines and the Sun Salutation sequence labels, extracting the real single movement(s) named inside rather than discarding or keeping the whole line as one garbled movement - 108 lines, decomposing to zero NET new movements because every component resolved to a movement already covered elsewhere; (4) sourcing and pattern-level muscle verification for every movement that survived (1)-(3) - 164 movement records, reusing an already-verified mv pattern where the new movement is biomechanically the same exercise (documented per-record with an inheritance note), and fresh web sourcing for genuinely new patterns, with every named yoga/Sanskrit asana checked individually against yoga-anatomy and PT/clinical sources rather than inferred from general knowledge.

totals.circuitDecompositionResult: Every AMRAP/EMOM/warm-up/cool-down circuit line sampled, plus the four Sun Salutation sequence labels, was manually decomposed. All of them resolved to component movements ALREADY individually present elsewhere in the library and already in either muscle-verification.json or this pass's own new-movement list (e.g. 'AMRAP 20 min: Box Jump (step down)' decomposes to 'Box Jump (step down)', already verified; 'Drills: A-skips, high knees, butt kicks' decomposes to three already-verified movements; 'Sun Salutation A' decomposes to Prayer Pose, Raised Arms, Hands to Feet, Equestrian Lunge, Eight-limbed Pose, Cobra, and Downward Dog - see sunSalutationConfirmation below). Net new movements contributed by circuit decomposition specifically: 0 - its value in this pass was confirming nothing real was being discarded.
totals.longTailNote: After all of the above, roughly 536 residual strings remained - reviewed in batches by eye rather than one-by-one with individual sourcing, and judged to fall into the same excluded categories as above (further sport-specific drills/named coaching programs such as 'Rob Jackson T1 running drills', cycling gear/wattage and swim interval labels, boxing/basketball skill rounds, rest/recovery/transition labels, balance-hold variants, or likely cosmetic duplicates of an already-covered movement that weren't individually traced down). This, plus the 22 ambiguous fuzzy-match candidates left genuinely unresolved (e.g. whether 'Thigh Stretch' matches the existing Butterfly Inner-Thigh Stretch or is something else), is the one honest limitation of this pass: given the scale (2,003 strings spanning strength, yoga, Pilates, running, swimming, cycling, boxing, AFL, basketball, golf, tennis, netball and rehab content), full individual verification of every single residual string was not completed. sunSalutationConfirmation.detail: 'Sun Salutation A', 'Sun Salutation B', 'Sun Salutation flow', and 'Sun Salutation (half rounds)' are circuit-style labels for the full pose sequence, not single movements - decomposed per this pass's own methodology into: Prayer Pose (Pranamasana) [new], Raised Arms (Hasta Uttanasana) [new], Hands to Feet (Pada Hastasana) [already covered - matches existing 'Forward Fold (knees soft)' image], Equestrian Lunge (Ashwa Sanchalanasana) [already covered in pass 1's visual-variants.json, variant new-057], Eight-limbed Pose (Ashtanga Namaskara) [new], Cobra (Bhujangasana) [new], and Downward Dog (Parvatasana) [new]. yogaSourcingDifficulty: Confirmed harder to source than the strength/EMG literature the original research relied on. ExRx.net - the backbone of the first two passes - has no yoga-asana coverage at all. Yoga Journal has dedicated, checkable anatomy pages for only a few poses in this batch (Tree Pose, Eagle Pose, Boat Pose, Warrior 3, Downward Dog); for most others (Chair Pose, Cobra, Crow Pose, Half Moon, Happy Baby, Pyramid Pose, Puppy Pose, Frog Pose, Eight-limbed Pose, Mountain Pose's specific muscle list) the best available sourcing was a mix of yoga-education sites (YogaUOnline, Yoga International), one academic-adjacent university yoga-anatomy reference (NC State), and in a few cases only commercial yoga/wellness blogs - a lower, more heterogeneous source tier than ExRx+NASM+EMG. Three genuine disagreements surfaced and are flagged in the per-movement notes rather than resolved: (1) whether Boat Pose is primarily an abdominal or a hip-flexor exercise; (2) the sleeper stretch vs. cross-body stretch for shoulder internal rotation (here an actual peer-reviewed RCT, McClure 2007, favors cross-body - the best-sourced disagreement in this batch, closer to the strength-literature standard); (3) inconsistent use of the name 'Hasta Uttanasana' across sources (a raised-arms pose here vs. a standing backbend elsewhere). A larger number of poses and mobility drills (Eight-limbed Pose, Revolved Triangle, Puppy Pose, Brettzel, Frog Pose, Mountain Pose's muscle list, Spiderman Lunge Stretch, Thoracic Open Book) could not clear the project's own two-source bar and are held at low or low-moderate confidence, flagged explicitly in their 'notes' field rather than presented as settled.
